{"metadata":{"description":"DSH plugin: delete_subagent tool + UI - release or permanently remove subagent sessions from the DeepSeek Harness web UI","id":"gh:1341472327","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-plugin-subagent-delete","slug":"heiheiha798/dsh-plugin-subagent-delete","topics":["cleanup","deepseek-harness","delete","dsh","dsh-plugin","dsh-plugin-market","dsh-plugins","subagent"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DSH plugin: delete_subagent tool + UI - release or permanently remove subagent sessions from the Dee"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"pSeek Harness web UI"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-plugin-subagent-delete"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that adds the missing subagent lifecycle interface:"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"- `delete_subagent` — permanently delete a subagent session and drop it from the session list
- `rel"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"ease_subagent` — stop / release a subagent without deleting its transcript
- `list_subagents` — list"},{"id":"p4s3","text":" the calling session's descendant subagents (including finished one-shot subagents)"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Verified against DSH `0.2.1-alpha.2`; compatibility shims keep `0.2.0-rc.2` and
`>=0.1.0-rc.8 <0.2.0"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"-0` working (declared range:
`>=0.1.0-rc.8 <0.2.0-0 || >=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0`)."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Why"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"DSH's built-in subagent control surface only provides `send_message`, `interrupt_agent`
and `list_ag"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"ents`. There is no delete/release endpoint, so finished one-shot and stale
continuable subagents kee"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"p accumulating in the web UI list. This plugin fills that gap
with an ownership-checked, model-calla"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"ble tool plus optional HTTP routes."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Restart the profile, then start a new session. The session gains three tools."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Tools"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"### `list_subagents`"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Returns the caller's descendant subagent tree: `id`, `label`, `mode`
(`one-shot` | `continuable` | `"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"external` | `unknown`), `activity`
(`running` | `inactive`), `depth`, `parentId`, `hasChildren` and "},{"id":"p14s3","text":"`present`
(whether the durable session artifact is still stored). A child whose catalog
branch could"},{"id":"p14s4","text":" not be read carries `unreadable`
(`corrupt` | `unsupported` | `unavailable`) and still counts as a "},{"id":"p14s5","text":"deletable
target. Children whose durable session was already permanently deleted are
omitted; pass `"},{"id":"p14s6","text":"include_absent: true` to list them (they report
`present: false`)."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"### `delete_subagent`"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Permanently removes the subagent:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"1. verifies the target is a descendant of the calling agent's session
(descendant discovery uses the"},{"id":"p18s2","text":" official `ctx.subagents.listDescendants`,
falling back to a persisted-header lineage walk);
2. when"},{"id":"p18s3","text":" the target is a Team member and the caller is the Team Lead, dismisses
it from the durable Team ros"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"ter through `ctx.agentTeams.dismissTeammate`, so
the Team panel stops listing the teammate;
3. stops"},{"id":"p18s5","text":" the live agent / releases a resident child Activation through the
official `ctx.subagents.drainChil"},{"id":"p18s6","text":"dren(parent, childIds)` seam, which also
detaches the child Session from the live store;
4. flushes "},{"id":"p18s7","text":"and (if still live) detaches the session from `ctx.sessions`;
5. removes the on-disk session log dir"},{"id":"p18s8","text":"ectory (both uuid spellings);
6. removes the `session_projcache` row;
7. removes the id from workspa"},{"id":"p18s9","text":"ce accounting and the archive set."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Without `recursive: true` a target that still has descendants is refused with
`has-descendants`. Del"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"etion is child-first and permanent. A target whose durable
session is already gone reports `already_"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"absent` instead of `not-found`, so a
subtree delete never aborts half-way. Each deleted row reports "},{"id":"p19s4","text":"`dismissed`,
which stays `false` when the target is not a roster member, the caller is not the
Lead,"},{"id":"p19s5","text":" or the composition mounts no Team service."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"### `release_subagent`"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Stops the current turn and releases a resident child Activation via
`ctx.subagents.drainChildren(par"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"ent, childIds)`, but keeps the durable
transcript. The subagent remains resumable with `send_message"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"t, childIds)`, but keeps the durable
transcript. The subagent remains resumable with `send_message`."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Web UI auto-refresh"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"A permanent delete removes the durable child, but an open client keeps its
cached session list and p"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"rojections until something invalidates them. This
plugin works around that gap without patching DSH:"},{"id":"p24s3","text":" after every permanent delete
the host publishes a short-lived marker session through the official
`"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"prepare → enter → announce → detach` lifecycle seam. The bundled web client
component (`lib/client.j"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"s`) watches the public `sessions.list` snapshot and,
when the marker child is removed (`api-session/"},{"id":"p24s6","text":"removed`), debounces 350 ms and
calls `sessions.refresh()` plus `sessions.refreshProjections(parentI"},{"id":"p24s7","text":"d)` for the
affected parents — the current dsh face (pre-0.2.1 releases used
`sessions.refreshSubage"},{"id":"p24s8","text":"nts(parentId)` and are still supported). Open web clients
therefore drop the deleted subagent withou"},{"id":"p24s9","text":"t a manual page reload. The marker's
`_no-cwd` artifact is swept after detach, so the refresh glue l"},{"id":"p24s10","text":"eload. The marker's
`_no-cwd` artifact is swept after detach, so the refresh glue leaves no residue."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Team sessions additionally lose the teammate from the Team panel: a teammate is
a durable `team/memb"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"er` fact, and `delete_subagent` terminates it through the
official Lead-only dismissal before removi"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"delete_subagent` terminates it through the
official Lead-only dismissal before removing the Session."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"One honest limit remains: the parent Session's `subagent/catalog` facts are
append-only durable hist"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"ory, so a deleted child can still appear as a
**historical row** in the parent's header catalog drop"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"down until that parent log
itself moves on. Removing the fact would mean rewriting a committed sessi"},{"id":"p26s4","text":"on
log, which dsh does not support. The sidebar session list is refreshed
normally."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## HTTP routes (web profiles)"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"For client integration and local debugging the host plugin registers:"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"- `GET  /dsh-plugin-subagent-delete/list?parentSessionId=<id>[&activity=…][&mode=…]`
- `POST /dsh-pl"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"ugin-subagent-delete/delete` `{ "parentSessionId": "<id>", "subagentId": "<id>", "recursive": false "},{"id":"p29s3","text":"}`
- `POST /dsh-plugin-subagent-delete/release` `{ "parentSessionId": "<id>", "subagentId": "<id>", "},{"id":"p29s4","text":""recursive": false }`"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"HTTP callers must name the same `parentSessionId` the target descends from; the
same ownership check"},{"id":"p30s2","text":" runs on every mutation."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"## Safety"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"- A subagent can only be deleted by its own session-tree ancestor. Foreign or
unknown ids return `no"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"t-your-subagent`; an id whose durable session is already
gone returns `already_absent` rather than a"},{"id":"p32s3","text":" hard failure.
- Running subagents are cancelled and awaited (15s quiescence bound) before
their fil"},{"id":"p32s4","text":"es are removed; the timeout never leaves a pending timer behind.
- File removal is confirmed before "},{"id":"p32s5","text":"workspace accounting is stripped, so a
failed delete cannot produce a half-removed row."}],"truncated":true}
